comment: Public Android SDK system images. sha1 is the 40-hex SHA1 from the SDK XML repository index (sys-img2-1.xml). These are emulator system images, not full AOSP build outputs. They are suitable for feasibility probing within the storage budget.

images.notes: Android 16 (API 36) x86_64 AOSP default system image. Verified available 2026-10-25. SHA1 from Google SDK XML; no SHA256 provided by Google in this index. This is the primary feasibility target.
Android 15 (API 35) x86_64 AOSP default system image. Fallback if Android 16 has incompatible HAL ABI.

limitations: These are emulator/SDK system images, not full AOSP build outputs from ci.android.com.
They contain system.img (and related images) for the AVD emulator. Composer3 HAL stubs may be present as AIDL passthrough or stub implementations, not a full HWC2/HWC3 vendor HAL.
The Google Android Build CI (ci.android.com) legacy API returns 403; the newer Build API v4 requires authentication.
Cuttlefish images (aosp_cf_x86_64_phone) would include full virtual hardware HALs but are not publicly downloadable without CI auth.
NTFS3 on the external disk does not support sparse files; 805 MiB will be fully allocated on disk.
No reflinks; no loop-device mount without root; guestmount via libguestfs available as unprivileged alternative.
